text:
tanya: heads-up — onboarding sampleapp fails when targeting Edge with Vite/SSR. works in node but preview-edge throws module resolution/runtime errors. anyone seen this pattern before?

leo: can you paste the deployment error and which bundler/version?

tanya: gist of the error from preview logs: `Error: Cannot use import statement outside a module` during startup. stack points into node's CJS loader. package.json for @redwood/inference in node_modules shows main/module/types but exports only lists ./package.json.

anjali: that's the classic exports mismatch. without a proper exports map bundlers pick different entrypoints (main vs module vs browser) and SSR builds can end up pulling the CJS file into an ESM runtime.

leo: quick repro I used locally:
1) scaffold minimal SSR server index.server.ts that imports the SDK
2) npm i (pulls published @redwood/inference)
3) `vite build --ssr` then `node dist/server/index.js` -> runtime fails with the same stack

tanya: rollup/webapack variants either succeed at build or produce TS type errors: `Could not find a declaration file for module '@redwood/inference'`. inconsistent behaviour across bundlers.

anjali: short-term app workaround: add a bundler alias to force the ESM entry: `resolve: { alias: { '@redwood/inference': '/node_modules/@redwood/inference/dist/index.esm.js' } }` for Vite/Rollup, and for webpack set `resolve.mainFields = ['browser','module','main']`. add this snippet to sampleapp README under Edge notes.

leo: long-term SDK fixes: add a full exports map that is explicit about import/require/types/browser. e.g. "\"exports\": { \"./\": { \"import\": \"./dist/index.esm.js\", \"require\": \"./dist/index.cjs.js\", \"types\": \"./dist/index.d.ts\", \"browser\": \"./dist/index.browser.js\" }, \"./package.json\": \"./package.json\" }". shipping types via exports fixes TS consumers that otherwise miss declarations.

anjali: also include `typesVersions` for older TS versions and add a CI smoke test that installs the built tarball and runs a matrix: `vite build --ssr`, `rollup -c ssr.rollup.js`, `webpack --config ssr.webpack.js`, and `tsc --noEmit`. fail the release on regressions.

tanya: thanks, I'll open a PR draft on the SDK repo with the exports map + types entry and a small CI job. will add the sampleapp README note as well.

pkg-bot: created issue sdk-packaging#109: "exports map + bundler smoke tests for ESM/CJS parity" (link: https://tracker.redwood/sdk-packaging/109).

ci-bot: ran quick prerelease smoke against sampleapp using the patched package tarball — Vite SSR now builds and runs in preview-edge when aliasing removed, but we should still land the exports map to avoid consumer hacks.

leo: final note — CloudEdge runtime requires ESM semantics for server modules; shipping ESM-first with a CJS fallback is the safest packaging strategy. keep CJS for older consumers but ensure exports makes the ESM entry the default for `import`.

anjali: i'll add a tiny unit test into packaging that checks `require.resolve('@redwood/inference')` and `import()` semantics in a Node 18/20 matrix during CI to catch accidental regressions.

 tanya: awesome. logging this under the onboarding-friction epic and will ping docs/eng for README updates once PR merges. thanks all! :rocket:
